body:
WHAT
The main (coding) model is never sent an image. A connection profile may name another saved profile as its 'vision model'; applying the profile brings that describer to the workspace. An attached image, an image read by the Read tool, or an image inside any tool result (for example an MCP screenshot) is sent to the vision endpoint and the written description, wrapped in a note saying the main model did not see the picture, enters the conversation as text. Without a vision model the toggle cannot be turned on, the picker refuses images and Read explains why.

WHY
Sending a picture to a model that cannot see it produced confident commentary on an image it never received, and the account was not in the transcript where it could be checked.

WHERE
engine/core/src/runtime/session.ts — visionUnavailableReason(), private describeImage() (visionProviderCache keyed on provider/baseUrl/contextWindow/apiKey, runInference with `provider` and `images`), describeImageForContext() (wraps with VISION_DESCRIPTION_WRAPPER), describeToolImages(content) applied where a tool result becomes a message, VISION_DESCRIBE_SYSTEM prompt; runInference(opts) is the only path that passes `images`. engine/core/src/runtime/engine.ts — withImageDescriptions(text, images) for user_message/steer_message, case "set_vision" refuses enabling without visionConnection. engine/tools/src/read.ts — IMAGE_TYPES branch in readTool.execute: refuses with the unavailable reason, caps at MAX_IMAGE_BYTES, else ctx.session.describeImageForContext. app/main/profiles.js — visionProfileId pointer on a profile, sanitizeProfile resolving visionName/visionModel, deleteProfile clearing dangling pointers. app/main.js — profiles:save validates visionProfileId, profiles:apply passes { profileId: profile.visionProfileId, enabled: true } to applyValidatedConnection, which writes settings.visionConnection / vision and MAGENTRA_VISION_API_KEY. app/main/connection.js — resolveVisionSelection(), currentVisionConnection().

TEST CHECKLIST
1. With a fake main provider and a fake vision provider (via providerFactory / visionConnection), a user_message carrying one image results in the main provider receiving only text messages (no content block of type 'image') whose text contains the <image-description source=...> wrapper with the fake vision provider's output.
2. With settings.visionConnection unset, a user_message with an image reaches the main provider as text containing 'could not be read' and the 'names no vision model' reason, and a non-fatal error event is emitted; the set_vision frame with enabled:true is refused with an error.
3. Read on a .png with vision unavailable returns isError:true and text containing 'you cannot see it'; with a fake vision provider it returns the wrapped description and records the read.
4. A tool result containing a part { type: 'image' } is converted by describeToolImages to a text part (description when vision is available, '[This tool returned an image. You have NOT seen it …]' otherwise) before the tool_result message is built.
5. profiles:save rejects visionProfileId equal to the profile's own id and rejects an unknown id; deleteProfile(id) clears visionProfileId on every profile that pointed at it; applying a profile with no visionProfileId deletes visionConnection and vision from the workspace settings and removes MAGENTRA_VISION_API_KEY from .env.
